summary: Shoppers see a dark appearance when their device prefers it, while the existing light appearance and shop functionality remain unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.refined: When the device prefers dark color scheme, every shop page uses a dark appearance with readable text, surfaces, links and controls.

risk.rationale: The new shared color treatment spans every shop page, and insufficient contrast or missed surfaces would make dark mode difficult to use.

acceptanceCriteria.original: Make no changes to light mode or any other functionality.
acceptanceCriteria.refined: When the device prefers light color scheme or has no dark preference, the existing light appearance remains unchanged, and existing shop functionality continues to work.

risk.rationale: Changes to shared styling could regress the established appearance or interfere with shopping and checkout.

decisions.decision: Automatically follow the device's dark color-scheme preference; do not add a manual toggle.
decisions.evidence: Asked how shoppers should activate dark mode; user selected automatic device preference.

decisions.decision: Apply the dark appearance across the shared shop pages while keeping the existing default/light colors intact.
decisions.evidence: Ticket AC2 requires no changes to light mode; all shop pages share style.css, and copilot-instructions.md requires preserving existing behavior and accessibility.

outOfScope: A manual theme toggle or saved theme preference
Changes to shop content, products, basket, or checkout behavior
